description: This file contains trigger decoder functions for Mazda engines in the rusEfi project, including initialization of trigger shapes for different Mazda engine configurations and sensor setups.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNaShape
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for Mazda Miata NA engine with specific event timings and synchronization settings.

methods.name: initialize_Mazda_Engine_z5_Shape
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Mazda engine with specific signal pattern and trigger events.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNb2Crank
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for Mazda Miata NB engine with crank sensor configuration.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNb1ShapeWithOffset
methods.description: Sets up trigger shape for Mazda NB engine with an offset for secondary trigger events.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNb1Shape
methods.description: Wrapper to initialize Mazda NB trigger shape with zero offset.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataVVtTestShape
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for Mazda VVT testing with specific offset.

methods.name: configureMazdaProtegeSOHC
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Mazda Protege SOHC engine with specific trigger events.

methods.name: configureMazdaProtegeLx
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Mazda Protege LX engine with specific trigger events and synchronization settings.
